protocol_correction_before_accepted_meas: R1 stopped on its first candidate warmup because the tooling incorrectly required exactly 28 hits. Four protected steps permit at most 32 hits, and legitimate threshold-driven interior recomputation reduces that count. R1 has no accepted measured pairs or report. R2 changes only this diagnostic bound to 0 < hits <= 32; candidate, threshold, protected steps, settings, sources, population, and every promotion gate are unchanged.
candidate_description: When both public request and native Stage CLI omit teacache_thresh, native I2V automatically uses the existing TeaCache residual policy at 0.25 with a frozen boundary2 schedule. Steps 0, 1, 18, and 19 always execute all 30 DiT layers for both CFG branches; only steps 2 through 17 may reuse residuals. Explicit request or Stage values including 0.0 and explicit 0.25 retain their historical behavior. T2V and the legacy direct-engine constructor remain uncached. No CUDA kernel arithmetic, solver, precision, frame count, resolution, sampling, public schema, codec, or client Fast/Quality control changes.
schedule: five repetitions; seeded arm order per repetition; fresh native Wan process per arm block; one excluded warmup per shape before its measured request; fixed wide,tall,square order within arm
cold_prefix_policy: model load and every warmup are retained separately and excluded from warm medians/p95; outliers remain in all statistics
source_policy: exact frozen real public FLUX.2 wide/tall/square PNG bytes and evaluation RGB from the bound baseline profile
client_policy: identical public POST /v1/visual/render requests with teacache_thresh omitted in both arms; no manual modality or frame-budget control
latency_reporting: every measured wide/tall/square public playable/complete artifact must be below 5000 ms; report per-shape and pooled median, p95, maximum, every raw value, and every outlier without selecting shapes or pairs
cancellation_protocol: one real non-streaming click-to-animate disconnect per arm, one second after observed native submit; record native abort terminal, client/health settlement, late native records and zero public media; immediate same-source retry must match that arm's exact MP4 hash. The route exposes no request id, so /abort ACK is NOT_APPLICABLE rather than fabricated.
analysis: report all raw latencies, median/p95/max/IQR/MAD, per-shape paired deltas, all quality values, cancellation timing, failures and outliers; no post-observation threshold or variant changes
promotion_rule: PROMOTED only when every NS-02 quality, per-geometry latency, pooled speed, cancellation and recovery gate passes with no lifecycle regression. Otherwise NOT_PROMOTED and remove the candidate from the final runtime. Numeric fidelity is not perceptual judging.
historical_candidate_policy: Task #79 automatic-i2v-teacache-0.25 and its failed evidence remain unchanged and diagnostic only; this v2 candidate is a distinct frozen boundary2 schedule, not a threshold sweep.
